name: OpenBesluitvorming - Incremental Sync
description: Inactive generic six-hour delta synchronisation. It only runs after the initial snapshot checkpoint is complete, consumes the documented /api/export/changes feed from the durable changes cursor, upserts changed documents through the document worker, deletes tombstoned document vectors, and commits its delta cursor only after both operations succeed.
